document.title: Roadsmith: roadside fix finder
document.description: Name the car problem, or answer two questions, and get a plain verdict, the tools to have ready and the steps to follow.
document.noscript: Roadsmith needs JavaScript to show its problem list. Turn it on in your browser settings and reload this page.

shell.hazard: Pulled over? Turn on your hazard lights and stay well clear of traffic.
shell.footer: Roadsmith gives general guidance for common car problems. It cannot see your car. If anything feels unsafe, treat it as a tow.

browse.title: Find the problem
browse.heading: What is going wrong?
browse.lede: Search for the problem or pick a common one. You get a plain answer and what to do.
browse.searchPlaceholder: Try flat tire, battery or smoke

empty.title: No problems match
empty.body: Nothing matches "{query}". Try a shorter word, or clear the search and pick a category.
empty.bodyCategory: Nothing in this category matches your search. Try a shorter word, or clear the search and the category.

diagnose.title: Help me find it
diagnose.lede: Two questions, then the most likely cause and what to do about it.
diagnose.disclaimer: This is a best guess from your answers, not a mechanic's diagnosis. If anything feels unsafe, treat it as a tow.

unknown.title: That question is not in the list
unknown.body: The address does not match any of the symptoms.

fix.label: Fix it here
fix.note: You can sort this out where you are.

limp.label: Drive carefully to a shop
limp.note: A temporary fix, then get it checked soon.

help.label: Get help
help.note: Do not drive it. Call a tow, a mechanic or roadside assistance.

helpBanner.title: Do not drive this car
helpBanner.body: Driving on could cause a crash or costly damage. Get help first, then use the steps below while you wait.

fix.stepsDone: Every step is done. If the problem is still there, get help.

tutorial.heading: Video tutorials
tutorial.body: Opens a YouTube search for {vehicle} and this problem in a new tab.
tutorial.bodyNoVehicle: Opens a YouTube search for this problem in a new tab. Add your vehicle on the home screen to narrow it.

nearby.heading: Find help nearby
nearby.note: Each link opens Google Maps in a new tab and searches near your location.
nearby.mechanicAction: Find a mechanic or tow truck
nearby.mechanicQuery: mechanic or tow truck near me

fix.stopHeading: When to stop and get help

highway.heading: If you are on a highway
items: Turn on your hazard lights. Get fully onto the shoulder, or leave at the next exit.
If it is safe to get out, leave on the side away from traffic and wait behind the guardrail.
If it is safe to do so, place a warning triangle well behind the car: 100 feet (30 m) or more on a fast road.
Never work on the traffic side of the car.
If you feel unsafe, stay buckled inside with your hazard lights on and call your local emergency number or roadside assistance.

unknown.body: The address does not match any problem Roadsmith knows about.
